candidate.title: Residual local marginal-evidence anchor
candidate.hypothesis: If frozen predictions already encode part of the local class prior, using H(log(pi)-log(q)) with q estimated from the same local TRAIN prediction marginal can reduce double-counting and improve development NLL over both prior and zero centers. Correct q-to-class alignment should matter. Local q is not guaranteed to be a source prior and may instead erase useful local information.
candidate.novelty_scope: UNASSESSED required-schema placeholder. Prior-ratio label-shift correction, Saerens-style adaptation and BCTS are close established mechanisms. A local TRAIN output marginal is a concrete but assumption-sensitive variant; no valid label-shift interpretation or novelty is claimed without separate checks.

adapter_payload.minimum_experiment: Both tasks, original partition, all three existing seeds and all 20 clients; TRAIN-only centers/fits, designated development scoring, no shared retraining.
controls: one-class cyclic permutation of q in residual center
diagnostics: center norms and distance to zero
known-offset synthetic numerical fixture, not task-performance evidence
adapter_payload.rejection: Reject if task-mean NLL fails to beat original prior or zero on either task, if misaligned q performs equivalently, or if gains are explained only by proximity to zero. Report between-seed reversals.
adapter_payload.memory_boundary: Streaming accumulator, q/pi/center and one probability row; vectorized temporaries and baseline saved logits require measurement. All added buffers discarded after fitting.

scientific_novelty_assessment: LOW_STANDALONE_NOVELTY: standard prior ratio plus established ridge center; local q source-prior interpretation unproved
